timeline.event: Tours 26 US states in the Crusade for Freedom
First rung before more than 400,000 people

tiers.everyday: The Freedom Bell was cast in England in 1950, toured the United States and was given to West Berlin. It first rang on 24 October 1950.
tiers.student: Berlin's district office records casting at Gillett & Johnston on 27 July 1950, a tour of 26 US states (the Crusade for Freedom, backed by about 16 million Americans), shipment on 25 August and a first ring on 24 October 1950 before more than 400,000 people.
